rules.v: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
rules.vi: Hukum ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku, atau undang-undang khusus memberi hak-hak intinya
rules.n: Labor law with a special regime for domestic work and a binding national collective agreement.

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib dan tersedia dalam bahasa yang dipahami pekerja
rules.n: Written letter of employment; a translation is customary.

rules.v: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
rules.vi: Upah minimum menurut undang-undang berlaku sama dengan pekerja lain
rules.n: Minimum pay set by the national collective agreement.

rules.v: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
rules.vi: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura
rules.n: Monthly pay slip and payment; limits on in-kind pay.

rules.v: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
rules.vi: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: 54 hours a week for live-in workers, 40 for others.

rules.v: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
rules.vi: Minimal 24 jam berturut-turut, tidak dapat diganti uang atas permintaan pemberi kerja
rules.n: 36 hours' weekly rest, 24 of them on Sunday.

rules.v: Equal to or longer than for other workers
rules.vi: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
rules.vi: Hanya aturan umum, tidak khusus pekerja rumah tangga atau tanpa sanksi

rules.v: Worker may choose to live out; live-in accommodation must be decent and private
rules.vi: Pekerja boleh memilih tinggal di luar; akomodasi di rumah harus layak dan privat
rules.n: Live-out or live-in; live-in accommodation must be suitable and private.

rules.v: Worker may change employer without the employer's consent
rules.vi: Pekerja boleh pindah tanpa persetujuan pemberi kerja
rules.n: Work permit not tied to one employer.

rules.v: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
rules.vi: Pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya rekrutmen

rules.v: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
rules.vi: Agen berizin dan bertanggung jawab kepada pekerja (pengembalian, biaya pulang atau tanggung renteng)
Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen
rules.n: Inspection of homes limited by the constitutional protection of the home.

rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya

rules.v: Included in the general social security system, including maternity
rules.vi: Termasuk dalam sistem jaminan sosial umum, termasuk kehamilan

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.n: C190 ratified; criminal law on labor exploitation.

rules.v: May form and join trade unions
rules.vi: Boleh membentuk dan bergabung dengan serikat

decisions.pe: Tunisian men who arrived by boat were held on Lampedusa and on ships without a legal basis, then flown home. The Grand Chamber found unlawful detention but not a collective expulsion.
decisions.pi: Pria Tunisia yang tiba dengan perahu ditahan di Lampedusa dan di kapal tanpa dasar hukum, lalu diterbangkan pulang. Majelis Agung menyatakan penahanan tidak sah tetapi bukan pengusiran kolektif.

decisions.pe: Italian ships picked up Somali and Eritrean migrants at sea and took them straight back to Libya. The Grand Chamber said this broke the ban on sending people to danger and on group expulsions.
decisions.pi: Kapal Italia mengangkut migran Somalia dan Eritrea di laut dan langsung membawa mereka kembali ke Libya. Majelis Agung menyatakan ini melanggar larangan memulangkan orang ke bahaya dan pengusiran kelompok.

decisions.pe: Return to a risk of torture cannot be balanced against security.
decisions.pi: Pemulangan ke risiko penyiksaan tidak dapat ditimbang dengan keamanan.

decisions.nm: Sharifi and Others v. Italy and Greece
decisions.pe: Automatic returns from Italian ports to Greece.
decisions.pi: Pemulangan otomatis dari pelabuhan Italia ke Yunani.

help.de: Free, anonymous helpline in many languages for people trafficked or severely exploited, including on farms (caporalato). Run for the Department for Equal Opportunities.
help.di: Saluran gratis dan anonim dalam banyak bahasa bagi korban perdagangan orang atau eksploitasi berat, termasuk di pertanian (caporalato). Dijalankan untuk Departemen Kesetaraan Kesempatan.

help.de: Volunteers give free social, health and legal help to foreign nationals, including undocumented people.
help.di: Relawan memberi bantuan sosial, kesehatan dan hukum gratis bagi warga asing, termasuk yang tidak berdokumen.

help.de: Rights association with a legal desk (sportello legale) for migrants. The number shown is the legal desk.
help.di: Asosiasi hak asasi dengan layanan hukum (sportello legale) bagi migran. Nomor yang tercantum adalah layanan hukum tersebut.
